name: LEAFID
description: A unique identifier assigned to each leaf, used to distinguish individual leaves in the dataset.

name: TREEID
description: A unique identifier assigned to each tree, used to distinguish individual trees in the dataset.

name: SIZE
description: A measurement representing the dimensions of a leaf, which may include metrics such as length and width.

name: COLOR
description: A descriptor of the visual appearance of a leaf, typically represented in terms of color categories or values.
